research_rationale:
Executive Order 14014 (February 10, 2021, 86 FR 9429) declares a national emergency with respect to the situation in Burma and blocks property of persons determined to be responsible for or connected with it. The order is operative on 2026-10-14. Its text has no sunset, expiry condition or revocation trigger. Because the order itself declared the emergency, it depends on the emergency staying in force under the National Emergencies Act; the held Presidential notices of February 7, 2022 (87 FR 7677), February 6, 2023 (88 FR 8205), February 7, 2024 (89 FR 8989), February 4, 2025 (90 FR 9111) and February 3, 2026 (91 FR 5663) continue it year by year, and the last one continues it beyond February 10, 2026, a date after the cutoff. The held eCFR text of 31 CFR 525.201 and 525.106, checked as of 2026-10-14, still implements the order, and an OFAC notice of March 2026 (91 FR 11595) records new designations under section 1(a)(iii)(D), which shows the order in operation. The Federal Register disposition note lists only cross-references (Executive Order 13742 and the Notice of February 3, 2026).
